answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the velvet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The whisper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the oasis is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
